# 2 Chronicles 26 — Disagreement Log

**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.5
- **EMET:** "And-he-was seeking God in-days-of Zechariah the-understanding in-vision-of God and-in-days-of his-seeking YHWH He-made-him-prosper God."
- **LOGOS:** "He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God, and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him prosper."
- **PNEUMA:** "He devoted himself to seeking God during the lifetime of Zechariah, who taught him the fear of God. As long as he sought the LORD, God gave him succes"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.
